concepts.title: Advanced Wizardry
concepts.description: the whole Abechai build, all 165 pages, mapped as the developmental arc the course itself teaches in: cosmology and the eight fields of study, then the sphere, the weapons and the materials, then the voice, the schools, the two printed spellbook levels and the ten trades

title: Abechai — Advanced Wizardry — DEEP INGEST, phased, batch 1 of 4 (50 pages, 2026-09-01/02)

concepts.title: Magic as the Second Self
concepts.description: magic as the first thing's awareness of itself, and a wizard borrowing that awareness at the far end of a long chain

concepts.title: The Four Worlds as an Operating Procedure
concepts.description: the four worlds as a failure diagnostic: anything started and never spoken is still sitting in the third world, formed and unfinished

concepts.title: Why the Source Needs a First God
concepts.description: the First God as the Source at a size the universe can survive, made that size deliberately, and the reason given is mercy

concepts.title: Additus and Nihilus — The Eight Verbs
concepts.description: why a cure is filed under the destroying force, and what that does to the system's morality

concepts.title: The Eleven Primordial and Four Primary Forces
concepts.description: two forces make eight behaviours, eight make eleven pairs, eleven make four elemental laws; morality enters at tier three

concepts.title: The Octovium
concepts.description: eight disciplines studied properly as already the practice rather than preparation for it

concepts.title: The School of Alterations
concepts.description: the school that works on events that have not happened, and the real address an unmanifested event is said to have

concepts.title: The School of Benedictions
concepts.description: object, person, place, self — and the blessing aimed back at the wizard is named the most powerful

concepts.title: The School of Divinations
concepts.description: divination reading what alteration can rewrite, so a prediction is a report on an editable object

concepts.title: The School of Enchantments
concepts.description: what is trained is a property of the voice, so once the throat is charged every ordinary word carries magical energy

concepts.title: The School of Healings
concepts.description: illness treated as an occupying enemy, and what that framing sets in the technique

concepts.title: The School of Invocations
concepts.description: the ladder that changes what the wizard is: a plead is a prayer, an impetration is an operation

concepts.title: The School of Lights
concepts.description: a school separated from its neighbours by intent alone, sharing planet, station and focal point

concepts.title: The School of Naturals
concepts.description: what leaves the body is a picture of an element rather than the element, and the drill answers for it

concepts.title: The School of Protections
concepts.description: the two operations a solitary practitioner cannot perform, in a curriculum written for one person alone

concepts.title: The School of Conjurations
concepts.description: summoning as resonance rather than request, and what that removes from the being's side

concepts.title: The Ten Schools as One Architecture
concepts.description: the schools as a filing system built by sorting existing incantations by effect, not a division of reality

concepts.title: The Charge-and-Project Drill
concepts.description: ten schools, one exercise: five minutes of breath, ten minutes of a two-stroke charge, then the right hand forward

concepts.title: The Eight Furnaces
concepts.description: the furnace colours as the spectrum in order, root to crown, so a colour is a position on a scale

concepts.title: Orisons, Artificium, Conjurations and Rituals
concepts.description: the Somatic Dynamic as a second channel: will written onto the matrix of the physical realm

concepts.title: The Wizardly Trades
concepts.description: trades as what general skills turned into once an interest kept pulling, rather than tracks a student picks

concepts.title: The Philosophical Sphere Solves a Latency Problem
concepts.description: the sphere as a topology change on a ten-station pipeline, not a power source

concepts.title: The Sphere Is a Thought-Form
concepts.description: a construct born from the wizard's own mind, whose power scales with how much they understand

concepts.title: Two Power Supplies and a Gearbox
concepts.description: conduct as wiring: three rings charged by righteousness, four by the universe, and Esophoros interlocking them

concepts.title: The Ring of Virtues
concepts.description: virtues glossed by what they do rather than why they are right: resentment hands control away, pessimism manifests

concepts.title: The Ring of Statutes
concepts.description: the outward half of the inner supply, and the statute that turns promises into unfinished spells

concepts.title: The Ring of Values
concepts.description: the claim that working singlehandedly against evil spurs the darkest pits, in a curriculum built for one person

concepts.title: The Esophoros Ring and the Lumen Score
concepts.description: thirty-two concepts priced 8, 6, 4 and 2; you choose eight; the sum is your sphere's Lumen

concepts.title: The Archetype Ring Buys Order by Shutting Doors
concepts.description: a ring that works by occupancy, so what it excludes is everything unchosen

concepts.title: Thirty-Two Universal Laws, and How to Nullify One
concepts.description: which laws are currently backing an object, and what follows from a law being present only while its conditions hold

concepts.title: The Ring of Deities
concepts.description: a wrong deity darkening the sphere and bending the wizard's morality, rather than producing a failed working

concepts.title: The Eight Universal Potentials
concepts.description: the thirty-two as a few intentions crossed with the ways of achieving them

concepts.title: The Energy Economy of Philius and Neikos
concepts.description: nothing is generated, so every operation is a transfer with a direction and a stated cost

concepts.title: The Quickening of the Philosophical Sphere
concepts.description: the rite that quietly enforces a requirement nothing states as a rule: every ring recalled aspect by aspect, from memory

concepts.title: A Word Is a Number Is a Code
concepts.description: speech addressed to nobody: a word is a number, the number a code, and the code resonates with what it belongs to

concepts.title: Celestial Names Are Verbs Plus EL
concepts.description: an angel's name as a verb naming what it does plus a divine half built from one letter repeated three times

concepts.title: The Four Magical Voices
concepts.description: registers defined partly by being kept out of ordinary speech, so the discipline is abstinence as much as skill

concepts.title: Magic Words Must Be in the Present Tense
concepts.description: the tense rule as an addressing rule: a present-tense verb has somewhere to attach and a future one does not

concepts.title: Four Weapons From Four Divine Essences
concepts.description: the essences as what make God describable, and the instruments as their physical ends

concepts.title: The Two Hidden Pillars
concepts.description: two diagonals crossing at Tiphareth, putting three pillars through one station

concepts.title: The Chalice Is a Curve
concepts.description: the cup's power as an argument about geometry: a curve that never reaches its axis accumulates instead of arriving

concepts.title: Why a Pentacle Is Written On
concepts.description: the quintessence answered as a sound: the fifth essence after Thought, the sound that becomes Light

concepts.title: The Sword and the Unseen
concepts.description: one property doing all the work: air cannot be seen, and neither can a thought

concepts.title: The Wand Carries All Four Worlds
concepts.description: the wand as the Middle Pillar, so four worlds run through it at once and coagulate into one burst

concepts.title: The Archprimes
concepts.description: an administered elemental world with named hierarchs, and coined names with no external attestation

concepts.title: Every Weapon Has a Shadow List
concepts.description: the negative column as half of what the instrument is, not a warning about misuse

concepts.title: Consecration Charges in Sunlight
concepts.description: the one procedure depending on conditions outside the practitioner: twenty-one hours of sun across seven straight days

concepts.title: The Ladder of Weapons
concepts.description: dagger, sword, scepter — with the only gate placed at the rung that hands an unfinished student the most dangerous weapon

concepts.title: The Altar and the Four Towers
concepts.description: a protective boundary made of four towers the operator imagines, with nothing drawn and nothing placed

concepts.title: Fumigation
concepts.description: twenty-three of forty incenses exist to remove or repel, so the room is not assumed to be empty and waiting

title: Abechai — Advanced Wizardry — DEEP INGEST, phased, batch 2 of 4 (50 pages, 2026-09-02)

concepts.title: The Anatomy of a Candle
concepts.description: body as the world, wick as the wizard, fire as the divine, flame as the two wills together

concepts.title: The Hood Dissolves the Individual
concepts.description: with the hood on, that person is no longer the individual but a representation of the divine

concepts.title: Scrying Devices Are Relay Points
concepts.description: the information exists in the tension between the wizard and the device, in neither one

concepts.title: The Eleven-Day Crystal
concepts.description: eleven consecutive days at the same hour, a noon on a high place, and a thirty-day penalty for breaking the chain

concepts.title: The Smoking Censer
concepts.description: a two-minute instrument for spiritual states, emotions and the mind, whose ashes cannot be buried at home

concepts.title: The Water Vase
concepts.description: two formulas, one to open the channel and one for the wit to read what comes down it

concepts.title: Numbers as Broadcast Devices
concepts.description: a grid is a transmitter, and the Master Numbers ladder from the material world to godhood

concepts.title: The Radial Tension
concepts.description: two objects facing, seen daily, with the incantation repeated twice every two hours until it manifests

concepts.title: Three and the Act of Synthesis
concepts.description: a third thing entirely independent of the two that made it, and a triangle traced over what has stalled

concepts.title: The Elemental Pentagram and the Doctrine of Five
concepts.description: knowing the path is wrong and lacking the will to leave it, and the Hierophant's gate on transformation

concepts.title: Six and the Union of Opposites
concepts.description: six minutes inside a star, three times a day, and a schedule that is really a decay rate

concepts.title: The Seven-Pointed Star
concepts.description: one holy name behind every seven, and a sword that cuts and escorts at the same threshold

concepts.title: The Eight-Fold Manifold
concepts.description: a six-fold world contained inside an eight-fold sphere, offered as the mechanism of magical power

concepts.title: Nine, and What Will Not Descend by Itself
concepts.description: three aspects through three worlds, stopping one floor above the one you live in

concepts.title: The Ten Fingers as a Planetary Keyboard
concepts.description: the whole Tree on two hands, Mercy right and Severity left, addressed by thumb to finger

concepts.title: The Platonic Solids as Containers
concepts.description: cages for elementals, five forbidden materials, and the one solid you may not set alone

concepts.title: Gold and the Authority Set
concepts.description: sapphire right, ruby left, a lion at the throat, and absolute authority promised from an outfit

concepts.title: Silver Against the Undead
concepts.description: the folklore answered rather than repeated, by way of the Moon as coagulating agent and giver of life

concepts.title: Iron and the Weekly Body Pass
concepts.description: a nail passed head to foot, then a whole week on a magnet before it can be used again

concepts.title: Copper Draws and Lead Holds
concepts.description: the one drill whose precaution protects everybody else in the room

concepts.title: Mercury Withdrawn, Aluminium Substituted
concepts.description: the one metal the system drops, and a man-made replacement holding a planet

concepts.title: Never Substitute One Metal for Another
concepts.description: dilution is fine and replacement is absolute, with the consequence never named

concepts.title: Every Stone Houses Someone
concepts.description: the four-step courtesy, the handbag prohibition, and a spirit that simply goes away

concepts.title: The Cleansing That Differs From the Common One
concepts.description: no sun and no moon; salt, a prayer, and a promise made to a stone

concepts.title: Programming Versus Enchanting
concepts.description: an operation that narrows a stone to one job, and the enchanted stone given to somebody who knows nothing

concepts.title: Protective and Grounding Stones
concepts.description: the placement grammar: right for what comes at you, left for what gets inside

concepts.title: Healing Stones by Organ
concepts.description: a dosing schedule, and a stone that must be emptied after every use

concepts.title: Communing and Energizing Stones
concepts.description: six minutes on the brow for a faerie, four days of fasting for a Universal Consciousness

concepts.title: Four Days of Fasting for the Supreme Beings
concepts.description: no sign to expect, and a warning about stopping once you have begun

concepts.title: Asking a Plant Before You Cut It
concepts.description: the only consent procedure here that ends with the practitioner handing something over

concepts.title: Oils Carry Incantations to Other People
concepts.description: the one material that must be made, and the anointing map that puts it on a body

concepts.title: The Drop Counts Are Not Arbitrary
concepts.description: a census of 45 drop specifications; the counts cluster by recipe rather than by function

concepts.title: Odin Paid Twice for the Runes
concepts.description: the eye bought wisdom and did not buy the runes; the carving is what frees him

concepts.title: The Three Initiatic Keys
concepts.description: twenty-four signs cut into three ættir, each rune a reading and a carried talisman at once

concepts.title: Reading Runes by Orientation
concepts.description: the runes that show nothing are counted, and the count says how far to yield

concepts.title: The Tarot as a Set of Talismans
concepts.description: seven shuffles, six crosses, and a sixteen-card spread with a sacrifice built into it

concepts.title: Fewer Words Reach Heaven Faster
concepts.description: one word is a True Word; two must be assimilated by the sphere before they descend

concepts.title: The Casting Syntax
concepts.description: school word, incantation, magic word: every spell in the book is printed incomplete

concepts.title: The Assistance Economy
concepts.description: spell level is a headcount of allies, and the first is made from the wizard's own life force

concepts.title: Six Conditions Before You Speak
concepts.description: five conditions and one act, with memorisation moving the words two worlds up

concepts.title: What the System Says It Cannot Do
concepts.description: six stated limits, two of them interlocks on the most abusable spells, and cats

concepts.title: Disclosure Severs the Channel
concepts.description: the content may circulate and the source may not, on pain of the connection closing

concepts.title: Choosing a Magical Name
concepts.description: Abrelin casts and Peter does not, and a third name told to nobody including the mentor

concepts.title: Reading Your Own Name in Numbers
concepts.description: the only fully worked demonstration in the volume, and it confirms itself

concepts.title: What the Drills Ask of the Senses
concepts.description: step three forbids the images step four commands; nobody is ever told to smell anything

concepts.title: The Cosmic Consciousnesses
concepts.description: forty-nine personified concepts, given to a beginner precisely because they cannot be used

concepts.title: The Formula Grammar
concepts.description: eleven exorcisms are eleven fillings of one sentence, and one still carries the old value

concepts.title: The NN Slot
concepts.description: variable substitution documented once, in a footnote, and relied on everywhere

concepts.title: Two Incantations Carry Everything
concepts.description: 23 and 21 references against a long tail; the reading order is not the working order

concepts.title: Philosophy as Magical Training
concepts.description: keep an open mind but a sceptical one, and the sphere's twenty-four arriving as a reading list

title: Abechai — Advanced Wizardry — DEEP INGEST, phased, batch 3 of 4 (50 pages, 2026-09-02)

concepts.title: Mythology and the Ten Degrees of Divine Beings
concepts.description: a ranked ladder of ten, three rungs of it held by people who used to be alive

concepts.title: Alchemy as the Third Discipline
concepts.description: decompose, fertilise, gain energy, catch light; offered as the recipe for anything at all

concepts.title: Mathematics and the Quaternary
concepts.description: the two forces the whole system runs on, derived from a plus sign and a minus sign

concepts.title: Kabbalah as the Art of Receiving
concepts.description: correspondence is arithmetic, not resemblance, and a number is an address a name can be recovered from

concepts.title: Astrology and the Zodiacal-Sidereal Split
concepts.description: one planet with seven handles, and a sky sorted by whether a constellation carries an element

concepts.title: Sacred Geometry and the Built Matrices
concepts.description: Stonehenge and the cathedrals as equipment still standing, and a shape sorted by which of four layers it reaches

concepts.title: Space as a Sheet and Time as Its Wrinkles
concepts.description: a flat sheet is a stopped clock, so a where and a when are one condition stated twice

concepts.title: The Magical Spectrum
concepts.description: seven bands, a working spellbook that covers the first three, and every ceiling in the volume explained at once

concepts.title: The Arcanist
concepts.description: the trade that runs trials and publishes its failures, in a corpus where no failure is recorded

concepts.title: The Bestiologist
concepts.description: eight creature categories, six sorting principles, and the claim that reading about a thing makes it likelier to come

concepts.title: The Conjurer
concepts.description: depth or breadth, an exile that expires, and the one permanent act: shutting a gate for good

concepts.title: The Diviner
concepts.description: an artificial eye whose main ingredient is the eye of a White Bull, specified entirely in a footnote

concepts.title: The Healer
concepts.description: medical training named first among the requirements, and healing by proximity named last

concepts.title: The Kabbalist
concepts.description: the secret study of how incantations come to be, held by one trade in a volume that prints seventy-eight of them

concepts.title: The Magus
concepts.description: the trade with no answers, ending on the largest claim in the book: guiding humanity invisibly

concepts.title: The Planemaster
concepts.description: planes made of laws that shape the planes made of places, stated once and never used

concepts.title: The Praetor
concepts.description: the dark arts studied on purpose, combat training explicitly not for fighting, and armour worn always

concepts.title: The Templar
concepts.description: the secret of composing rites, six components and a rule that appears nowhere in the volume

concepts.title: The Uses and Types of Chalices
concepts.description: eight cups and you only own one; drinking is what closes the circuit

concepts.title: The Uses and Types of Pentacles
concepts.description: the one weapon that cannot be reused, because the operation is written on it

concepts.title: The Uses and Types of Swords
concepts.description: thirty-six inches, no gory decoration, and authority produced by a shape being recognised

concepts.title: The Uses and Types of Wands
concepts.description: gather, channel, focus, release; the traced sigil aims it and the spoken word lets it go

concepts.title: Tin and the Jupiter Set
concepts.description: joy at the right thigh and sight at the neck; the placement is the sorting rule

concepts.title: Lead and the Saturn Set
concepts.description: square protects from what happens, round changes who you are, and only the outline differs

concepts.title: Number One and the Monogram
concepts.description: a one-word spell is not a short spell, it is the number One performed

concepts.title: Number Four and the Tetractys
concepts.description: the cross expels nothing; it fills a space until there is no room left

concepts.title: The Master Numbers
concepts.description: nine rungs to godhood, and the only stated rule is that craving the last one disqualifies you

concepts.title: The Four Cosmogonic Aspects in the Sphere
concepts.description: the light repels by seniority rather than by force, and the practitioner does nothing while it happens

concepts.title: The Eight Magical Directions
concepts.description: a filter, not an amplifier: the universe answers only where something was placed

concepts.title: Illumination, Initiation, Ascension, Transenation
concepts.description: the mysteries and the authority to use them arrive as two separate grants, and only one is printed

concepts.title: The Logos Across Four Traditions
concepts.description: image gave us Reason and likeness gave us Voice, and the Voice is the only channel that was ever open

concepts.title: The Twelve Dimensions of a Conjuration
concepts.description: the largest formula here has a slot for the reason, and ten dimensions are listed against a stated twelve

concepts.title: The Four Forms of Artificium
concepts.description: similar effects joined, different effects woven, and a sentence written in the air

concepts.title: The Anatomy of an Orison
concepts.description: eight parts named, three printed per entry, and the two missing ones are sound and sight

concepts.title: The Liturgical Year
concepts.description: sixteen rites named, none printed, and the twelve monthly ones need other wizards

concepts.title: First Level Alterations: Formos
concepts.description: the one charm in the volume that explains itself, and the explanation is a change of impression

concepts.title: Second Level Alterations: Mutatios
concepts.description: charge a stone clockwise and say the activity in a very slow voice

concepts.title: First Level Benedictions: Benedictus
concepts.description: bless before you enchant, because the blessing is what makes an object absorb better

concepts.title: Second Level Benedictions: Benedicci
concepts.description: five limits of five different kinds, and an elemental blessing that gives you four places rather than four powers

concepts.title: First Level Divinations: Auguros
concepts.description: vagueness and emptiness is not a failure; it means somebody took it

concepts.title: Second Level Divinations: Vates
concepts.description: the trap-detector returns the motive, which is why it is useless against a rotten floorboard

concepts.title: First Level Enchantments: Fascinos
concepts.description: a remembering zone needs something to remember, which is why the charm needs real work behind it

concepts.title: Second Level Enchantments: Ensalmos
concepts.description: three rescues for people who cannot tell they were got at, and eight workings sealed in one object

concepts.title: First Level Healing: Salve
concepts.description: hourly warm water for eight hours, brandy in the vial, and an angel whose brief is keeping wizards working

concepts.title: Second Level Healing: Curo
concepts.description: the only hospital instruction in four hundred pages, and a charm that admits it only damps the signal

concepts.title: First Level Invocations: Petos
concepts.description: the anti-persecution charm works on the pursuer, by making them repent

concepts.title: Second Level Invocations: Apelos
concepts.description: communicate what comes through the channel, never how it came; a book with no lineage is what that produces

concepts.title: First Level Lights: Lucis
concepts.description: nobody is acted on; one person is lit and the room sorts itself

concepts.title: Second Level Lights: Iluminos
concepts.description: three conditions guard a knowledge channel and none guards the charm that eradicates people

concepts.title: First Level Naturals: Meteorikos
concepts.description: a mountain where wind and earth meet, the psalm ten times, starting precisely at 3:00 PM

title: Abechai — Advanced Wizardry — DEEP INGEST, phased, batch 4 of 4 — INGEST CLOSE (15 pages, 2026-09-02)

concepts.title: Second Level Naturals: Telurikos
concepts.description: cast five full days after the first snow; the only working timed off something you have to be there to see

concepts.title: First Level Protections: Auxilium
concepts.description: the circle fails the moment you strike out of it, and one charm requires the recipient to have asked

concepts.title: Second Level Protections: Guardos
concepts.description: the fear charm hides the heart rather than adding courage, and the monsters lose their grip

concepts.title: First Level Conjurations: Conjuratos
concepts.description: every failure in the school is a failure of manners, and the dwarf is infuriated by greed twice over

concepts.title: Second Level Conjurations: Conjuros
concepts.description: the hero judges whether your fight is just, and you begin to resemble whoever you called

concepts.title: The Practice of the Consciousnesses
concepts.description: four fields to ponder, no count, no marker, and a result recognised only years later

concepts.title: The Voice of Prayer
concepts.description: the only voice with no specification, because the specification is you

concepts.title: The Voice of Magic
concepts.description: clarity before power, because the beings obey what they recognise rather than who speaks

concepts.title: The Voice of Ceremony
concepts.description: two audiences at once, and the second one never leaves the room

concepts.title: The Voice of Ritual
concepts.description: the practitioner is joined to the structures first, and only then is formation tuned

concepts.title: The Psalm as a Power Source
concepts.description: three reasons of three different kinds, and the psalm is absorbed into the spell before it is spoken

concepts.title: Magical Symbols, Somatic Movements and Sekinoth
concepts.description: four elemental aspects of casting, two of them named and withheld

concepts.title: The Magical Levels of an Incantation
concepts.description: a level is a price, and the gate on every higher one is a being made from your own life force

concepts.title: Greater Rituals and the Raising of the Temple
concepts.description: the Ministers are the building; everything printed in the volume is the one-person version

concepts.title: The Four Worlds Hold Four Things
concepts.description: numbers to addition to geometric expansion to the shell of a nautilus, in four steps
